dict.string: casa-desk reads your calendar so your assistants can answer questions about your schedule, and adds or changes events only when you approve it.
casa-desk reads your reminders so your assistants can tell you what is due, and adds or completes them only when you approve it.
casa-desk looks people up in your contacts so your assistants know who is who, and adds or updates a contact only when you approve it. It never deletes contacts.
casa-desk works with Notes, Mail and Messages through their own scripting, only when you ask. Sends need your approval of the exact text.
